ops.title: Codex parsing deferred-scope register (post-P8)
ops.body:
The codex transcript-parsing plan (P0–P8, landed on main through `7fbe7c6`) shipped its approved scope: typed CodexEntry parse + lowering, probe/ingress gateway, discovery, py facade + sniffing, typed tool calls, CLI `--provider`, subagent join, docs. The following were **deliberately deferred**, with rationale — pick up only with fresh evidence or demand:

- **Mining/sentiment/judge legs** — user-approved deferral at plan time; the lifted activity/query layers work over lowered codex entries, but no codex-aware detectors/scores exist.
- **Typed py views over CodexEntry / `parse_typed`** — no consumer today; would add a large generated-view surface (`.pyi` drift gate) for zero users. The lowered `Entry` stream is the supported surface.
- **zstd decompression of compressed rollouts** — discovery flags `.jsonl.zst` files but does not parse them; `find_transcript` returns None for compressed-only sessions. Needs a zstd dep decision in the core crate.
- **Per-entry codex usage grafting** — `token_count` carries no turn/request id and totals move after `sub_agent_activity` with no assistant response between; v1 exposes the session-level `CodexUsageAggregate` only. Grafting returns only if a fixture matrix proves deterministic request association, multi-agent included.
- **`BashCall.workdir` typed slot** — codex `exec_command` workdir stays in `.raw`; type it if a consumer needs it.
- **Resumable codex fold state** — codex lowering is whole-file (not suffix-composable); `Watcher`/CLI `watch`/`parse_event` stay Claude-only, transcache consumers whole-file reparse. A resumable fold is a later optimization.
- **OpenAI pricing table** — `cost_of` raises NoPricing for codex models by contract; explicit non-goal follow-up.
